title: Policy Form Register: Loan Interest Accrual Conventions of Whole Life Insurance for Anniversary Capitalization
content:
The part of a year for which an anniversary capitalization on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy charges each piece of principal follows the loan-interest accrual convention printed in the policy form, which the issue date sets.

| Policy form (issue date on the policy record) | Part of a year charged for a piece of principal |
|---|---|
| Issued before January 1, 1985 | Whole policy months from the date that piece starts bearing interest to the anniversary, over **12**; a remaining part month is not charged |
| Issued from January 1, 1985 through December 31, 2004 | Actual calendar days from that date to the anniversary, over **360** |
| Issued on or after January 1, 2005 | Actual calendar days from that date to the anniversary, over **365** |

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

## Same piece, three forms (hypothetical piece bearing interest from October 20, 2023 to an anniversary of March 1, 2024)

| Policy form | Count | Part of a year |
|---|---|---|
| Issued 1981 | 4 whole months (October 20 to February 20; the days to March 1 are a part month) | 4 over 12 |
| Issued 1996 | 133 actual days | 133 over 360 |
| Issued 2011 | 133 actual days | 133 over 365 |

**Form boundaries.** A policy issued on December 31, 1984 accrues by whole months; one issued on January 1, 1985 on a 360-day year; one issued on December 31, 2004 on a 360-day year; one issued on January 1, 2005 on a 365-day year.
